dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures are concentrated on the posterior flank. These exhibit a soft-edged perimeter that transitions from high-intensity pixels to a darker interior. One prominent annulus is nearly circular, while surrounding ones are elongated and open-ended.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Clusters of small, solid light-grey pixel groups are located primarily along the ventral-lateral margin. These lack internal gradients and appear as high-contrast, asymmetrical punctate marks distinct from the larger ring patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-posterior region form an irregular quadrilateral. A grouping of three high-intensity blobs anterior to these rings forms a distinct scalene triangle.
